message:
We love being gloriously over-prepared! It’s like having a cozy safety net woven from a bit of foresight and a sprinkle of planning. 

One of the best tools we've come across is a resource from Ready.gov that helps us think through our family plans. It’s a gentle reminder that a little preparation can go a long way in making us feel more secure in our daily lives. Plus, who doesn’t enjoy checking off a well-organized list? 😊 

What’s your favorite tip for staying prepared? We’d love to hear your tricks!
